requirements_summary: Workload: sustained high-volume chat (avg 150k msgs/day), peak spikes up to 1.2M msgs/day during incidents — need graceful degradation.
Latency: P95 end-to-end <= 400ms for deflection quick-replies; agent assist streaming targets <= 200ms incremental tokens.
Throughput: concurrent open chats ~12k during peak; batching must preserve SLA for interactive flows.
Cost sensitivity: target blended unit cost < $0.0006 per user message (token equivalent); quantization & caching required.
Model preferences: prefer open/model zoo variants (13B quantized) with Redwood-verified perf; fallback smaller models for low-sensitivity flows.
Routing/fallback: automatic routing by policy (latency-sensitive vs cost-sensitive), region-aware failover to dedicated capacity in us-east.
Tool-calling: need secure tool calling for CRM lookup & ticket creation (audit + idempotency), stubbed for POC with limited permissions.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown per route, per-model, and per-customer segment; alerts when unit economics deviate >15%.
Data controls: retention controls, ability to purge PII from prompt cache, audit log retention 2 years for legal requests.
